en: A black‑and‑white view of a massive stone Neo‑Renaissance/Neo‑Baroque style public building on a corner lot. The façade is richly ornamented with tall Corinthian columns, statuary in niches and on the roofline, decorative bas‑reliefs, and a heavily rusticated ground floor. Several arched entrances with steps lead into the building. In the foreground there is a formal garden or square with paths, low iron fences, and early 20th‑century pedestrians in long coats and hats. The image edges are worn and irregular, suggesting an old photographic postcard or plate.
